# RoxyAPI: the Spiritual OS layer for agentic AI

> **Base URL:** `https://roxyapi.com/api/v2`. Every path below is relative to it.

One API key for 18+ insight domains (Western Astrology, Vedic Astrology, Forecast, Human Design, Chinese Astrology, Feng Shui, Mesoamerican Astrology, Vastu Shastra, Numerology, Kabbalah, Tarot Reading, Biorhythm, Ayurveda, I-Ching Oracle, Crystals and Healing Stones, Dream Interpretation, Angel Numbers, Location and Timezone), 261+ endpoints, planetary positions read directly from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris and verified against NASA JPL Horizons, and every calculation held by 3,683 gold standard tests. Readings come back as structured data with editorial interpretation text, translated into 10+ languages via `?lang=` on translated endpoints. Remote MCP servers, typed SDKs for TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#, Go, and Rust, drop-in UI components and copy-paste widgets, and open source Templates all run on this one document.

## AI agents: Remote MCP

Every domain has its own Remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP at `https://roxyapi.com/mcp/{domain}` (for example `/mcp/astrology`), 258+ tools in all, with nothing to install or host. Add the URL to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT or any MCP client, or connect from the OpenAI Agents SDK and Gemini ADK. Coding agents that build against this API use the documentation server at `/mcp/docs`. Setup for every client: [roxyapi.com/docs/mcp](https://roxyapi.com/docs/mcp).

## Authentication

Send your key as `X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY` (recommended), as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY`, or as the `?api_key=` query parameter for quick tests. Keep secret keys on a server; publishable keys are for the browser.

## Responses and limits

Clean JSON with no wrapper. An error returns `{ "error", "code", "doc_url" }`: `error` is readable and may change wording, `code` is stable and the one to switch on, and `doc_url` links to the fix for that exact code.

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Used` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` for your monthly allowance, which resets on the 1st of each month at 00:00 UTC. Each plan also has a per-minute limit for bursts, from 600 requests per minute on Starter; going over it answers `429` with a `Retry-After` and never counts against the month.

## Errors

Every code the API returns, also published machine-readably as `x-error-codes` on the `info` object of this document:

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| 400 | [`validation_error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#validation_error) | A field is missing or invalid. The body lists every failing field at once in issues, each with its path and the expected shape. |
| 400 | [`bad_request`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#bad_request) | The request was rejected as a whole, for example a body that is not valid JSON or a date range that ends before it starts. |
| 400 | [`date_out_of_range`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#date_out_of_range) | A date lies outside the span the planetary positions are served for. The error names the supported dates. |
| 400 | [`invalid_branding`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#invalid_branding) | The report branding cannot be used, for example a logo that is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image. |
| 400 | [`logo_fetch_failed`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#logo_fetch_failed) | The report logo could not be fetched: it must be an HTTPS URL on a public host that answers within the size limit. |
| 400 | [`unsupported_character`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unsupported_character) | The report text holds a character no report font draws. The error names it: remove or replace it. |
| 401 | [`api_key_required`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#api_key_required) | No API key was sent. |
| 401 | [`invalid_api_key`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#invalid_api_key) | The key sent is malformed or cannot be verified. |
| 401 | [`api_key_revoked`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#api_key_revoked) | The key was valid once and has since been revoked from the account page. |
| 401 | [`subscription_not_found`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#subscription_not_found) | The key verifies, but the subscription behind it no longer exists. |
| 401 | [`subscription_inactive`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#subscription_inactive) | The subscription behind the key is cancelled, expired or suspended, or a trial is past its end date. |
| 401 | [`publishable_key_not_allowed_on_mcp`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#publishable_key_not_allowed_on_mcp) | A publishable key was used on a Remote MCP server, which takes a secret key. |
| 401 | [`invalid_client_ip`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#invalid_client_ip) | A keyless request could not be attributed to a caller. |
| 401 | [`unauthorized`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unauthorized) | Authentication failed with no more specific reason to give. |
| 403 | [`forbidden`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#forbidden) | The key is valid, but this request is not permitted. |
| 403 | [`origin_required`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#origin_required) | A publishable key with an origin allowlist was used with no Origin header, as from a server or a native app. |
| 403 | [`origin_not_allowed`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#origin_not_allowed) | The calling site is not on the origin allowlist of this publishable key. |
| 404 | [`not_found`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#not_found) | Nothing is served at this path, or the identifier in it does not exist. A path miss adds suggestions, the closest real endpoints. |
| 405 | [`method_not_allowed`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#method_not_allowed) | The path exists for a different HTTP method. The body lists the accepted methods in allow, as does the Allow header. |
| 409 | [`conflict`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#conflict) | The request cannot be applied in the current state. |
| 410 | [`gone`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#gone) | The path was removed permanently. |
| 413 | [`payload_too_large`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#payload_too_large) | The request body is larger than the API accepts. A body far over the cap is refused before it reaches the API and returns a bare 413 with no JSON body. |
| 415 | [`unsupported_media_type`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unsupported_media_type) | A request with a body was sent without Content-Type: application/json. |
| 422 | [`unprocessable_entity`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#unprocessable_entity) | Every field is valid, but the combination cannot be computed. |
| 429 | [`rate_limit_exceeded`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limit_exceeded) | The monthly request allowance is used up. Retry-After gives the seconds to the reset. |
| 429 | [`rate_limit_per_minute`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limit_per_minute) | The per-minute limit of the plan was reached. Retry-After gives the seconds to the next minute, and the monthly allowance is not charged. |
| 429 | [`rate_limited`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#rate_limited) | A rate limit was reached, reported without the plan detail. |
| 429 | [`free_tier_exhausted`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#free_tier_exhausted) | A keyless request has used up its trial allowance. |
| 429 | [`reports_rate_limited`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#reports_rate_limited) | Too many reports were requested this minute. Retry-After gives the seconds to the next minute. |
| 500 | [`internal_error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#internal_error) | The request failed inside our service. Retry with exponential backoff. |
| 503 | [`compute_saturated`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#compute_saturated) | Heavy calculations are briefly at capacity. Send the same request again after Retry-After seconds. |
| 503 | [`reports_busy`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#reports_busy) | Report rendering is briefly at capacity. Send the same request again after Retry-After seconds. |
| 503 | [`report_render_timeout`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#report_render_timeout) | The report took too long to render. Send the same request again. |
| Any | [`error`](https://roxyapi.com/docs/errors#error) | A fallback for a status with no more specific code. The status and the error field carry the signal. |
